profile.headline: Software Engineering Consultant (part-time contract) at Whiterabbit.ai
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer with 10+ years at Oracle, Google, Microsoft, and Nordstrom, most recently doing part-time contract engineering at WhiteRabbit.ai. I stepped back from full-time work to focus on my family, and I'm now returning to full-time engineering with fresh perspective and current skills. Open to software engineering roles in the Dallas area or remote.

positions.title: Software Engineering Consultant (part-time contract)
positions.description:
- Built Python tooling to ingest and transform data from many CSV sources, loading cleaned datasets into Google Cloud SQL and Google Cloud Storage as part of a repeatable data workflow  
- Helped quantify and reduce PHI exposure by deidentifying images and tabular records at scale 
- Relabeled imaging datasets at scale (cloud and on-prem) and rebuilt preprocessing scripts to standardize datasets across studies
(Python, Google Cloud SQL, Google Cloud Storage, AWS, GitHub, Notion)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built web UI with React/Redux and REST APIs to power virtual stylist experiences on Product Detail and The Styling Hub 
- Wrote unit and integration tests using Mocha/Chai, Cypress, and Storybook 
-Implemented Swift features to support UI A/B testing in the iphone mobile app
(React, Node.js, Swift)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Delivered new features for the Windows Store platform end to end 
- Built internal tools for data fixing and data migration 
- Provided live-site support — bug fixes and onboarding new customers to internal APIs 
(C#, MSSQL, Cosmos, Scope)

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Developing a web and mobile application dedicated to issue management for data centers commissioning stages.
- Participated in the design of the application and underlying APIs, being also closely involved with the BAs and business client to understand and meet the requirements for new features and enhancements.
- Implemented 30% of the backend APIs to be called by both platforms.
- Leaded the web development which was the first release to end users.
- Implemented core components for android, including UI, backend and offline functionality.
(Java, MySQL, Google Cloud Platform, Javascript, HTML, CSS and AngularJS)

Tech lead for an application that integrates a third party LMS system with Google HR data to facilitate training to Google employees.
(Java, Dremel and SQL)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed new features and provided support on existing functionality for Oracle Incentive Compensation product. Using ADF Framework, Java and PL/SQL.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
* Provided support to business users during the implementation of Fusion CRM application included several rounds of UAT (User Acceptance Testing) phases.
* Performed QA testing. Bug tracking collaborating across global teams within the organization.
* Created test cases for performance and functionality testing and automated performance test using OpenScript. 
* Developed PL/SQL scripts for the purpose of checking the data integrity of production data and QA Testing.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
* Developed functional specifications documents for various projects including risk assessment, documentation tracking, data validation and incident monitoring. 
* Performed QA testing and bug tracking for various projects and created test cases for performance and functionality testing.
* Functioned as the main liaison between the business users and the development staff to ensure proper implementation within the expected timetable.
* Provided application and production support to business users for a financial company web application with more than 500 users.
* Developed reports with the purpose of monitoring the use of the distinct applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Development of internal web applications for a financial company using Java, Struts, Websphere, Sybase.

positions.description:
Server Administration
Development of Website Portals for the Exchange Students Department.
Development of Spanish Exam online.
